description.p: TimeWorm is a lightweight GTK4 time tracking application designed for freelancers and small teams. Track time per customer and project with live timers or manual entries.
TimeWorm ist eine schlanke GTK4-Zeiterfassungs-App für Freelancer und kleine Teams. Erfasse Zeiten pro Kunde und Projekt mit Live-Timer oder manuellen Einträgen.

ul.li: Customer and project management with hourly rates
Live timer and manual time entry
Export to Excel, CSV and PDF

description.p: Initial release with full time tracking, reporting and export.
